description: Per-isotope binding table at the 242-ppb nucleon level. Binding: D +23%, T +6%, 3He +13%, 4He +3.6%, 6Li +4.8%, 7Li +3.9%, 9Be +3.5%, 10B +3.9%, 12C +3.3%.
